title: KMM PR Review Plan
description: Master plan persisted to ~/.kmm-pr-review/<repo-hash>/<branch>/plan.json. Each file gets one entry. Phase 5 fails loudly if any entry has status != 'done' or 'cache-hit'.

repo_hash.description: Hash of the repo's origin URL + root path, used to key state directory.

base_ref.description: Base ref the diff is computed against (e.g. 'origin/master').

head_sha.description: Current HEAD SHA. Used for cache invalidation on rebuild.

file.description: Repo-relative path. For renames, the new path.

old_file.description: For renames/migrations: the master-side path. Used to load the master baseline for attribution.

rules_to_load.description: List of references/rules/<name>.md files to load for specialists reviewing this file.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the file's content as it appears in the PR. Used with rules_hash to key the cache.

rules_hash.description: SHA-256 of the concatenated content of rules_to_load. Cache hit requires content_hash AND rules_hash to match.

is_migration_file.description: True if this file is part of the detected migration.
